blocks.zh: 5.0 Extractables and Leachables Evaluation 萃取物與浸出物評估 (Part B)
blocks.en: 5.0 Extractables and Leachables Evaluation (Part B)

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標（下篇）
blocks.en: Learning Objectives (Part B)

blocks.zh: 了解萃取物研究中半定量評估的方法適用性要求（5.6節）
blocks.en: Understand the method suitability requirements for semiquantitative evaluation in extractables studies (Section 5.6)

blocks.zh: 掌握浸出物識別的分類架構：unknown、tentative、confirmed（5.6節）
blocks.en: Master the classification framework for leachable identification: unknown, tentative, confirmed (Section 5.6)

blocks.zh: 理解 AET（Analytical Evaluation Threshold）的定義及其與 ICH Q3D 元素雜質閾值框架的對應關係（5.7節）
blocks.en: Understand the definition of the AET (Analytical Evaluation Threshold) and how it parallels the ICH Q3D elemental impurities threshold framework (Section 5.7)

blocks.zh: 區分三類化合物對應的三個閾值層級，並理解 SCT 與 TTC 的概念連結（5.7節）
blocks.en: Distinguish the three threshold levels that correspond to the three classes of compounds, and understand the conceptual link between the SCT and the TTC (Section 5.7)

blocks.zh: 掌握完整 E&L 評估結論的要素，及持續製程驗證在 E&L 管理中的應用（5.8節）
blocks.en: Master the elements of a complete E&L evaluation conclusion and the application of continued process verification in E&L management (Section 5.8)

blocks.zh: 5.6 Data Evaluation 數據評估
blocks.en: 5.6 Data Evaluation

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 半定量評估 (Semiquantitative Evaluation): 萃取物研究不要求每個峰都有對照標準品精確定量，而是以相對響應因子（relative response factors）或內標進行估算。這在「偵測全貌」階段已足夠，降低了分析資源投入。
blocks.en: Semiquantitative Evaluation: An extractables study does not require every peak to be quantified precisely against a reference standard. Instead, amounts are estimated using relative response factors or an internal standard. This is sufficient for the "detect the full picture" stage and reduces the analytical resources required.

blocks.zh: 浸出物識別三階層：
blocks.en: Three tiers of leachable identification:

blocks.zh: Unknown（未知）： 無法確認結構，僅知 MS 特徵或化學物質類別
blocks.en: Unknown: The structure cannot be confirmed; only the MS signature or the chemical class is known

blocks.zh: Tentative（暫定）： 有合理推測但缺乏標準品確認
blocks.en: Tentative: A reasonable structural assignment exists but has not been confirmed with a reference standard

blocks.zh: Confirmed（確認）： 有對照標準品與保留時間雙重確認
blocks.en: Confirmed: Identity is confirmed by both a reference standard and retention time

blocks.zh: 這三個層級決定了後續毒理評估的路徑與優先順序。
blocks.en: These three tiers determine the path and priority of the subsequent toxicological evaluation.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 把浸出物分析想像成犯罪現場鑑識：
blocks.en: Think of leachable analysis as crime scene forensics:

blocks.zh: 萃取物研究 = 採集所有可能的嫌疑人（controlled conditions，條件誇張但全面）
blocks.en: Extractables study = collecting every possible suspect (controlled conditions, exaggerated but comprehensive)

blocks.zh: MS 偵測 = 採集指紋（偵測訊號）
blocks.en: MS detection = lifting fingerprints (detecting the signal)

blocks.zh: 標準品比對 = 比對指紋資料庫（confirmed）
blocks.en: Standard comparison = matching against the fingerprint database (confirmed)

blocks.zh: 無標準品時 = 嫌疑人描述（tentative/unknown）
blocks.en: No standard available = a suspect description (tentative/unknown)

blocks.zh: 沒有找到完整身分的化合物，並不等於安全，而是必須用閾值方法（Section 5.7）決定是否需要進一步調查。
blocks.en: A compound whose identity has not been fully established is not necessarily safe; the threshold approach (Section 5.7) must be used to decide whether further investigation is needed.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 浸出物可出現萃取物未偵測到的新物質！ 原因是藥品基質的化學環境可誘發氧化、降解或藥物-浸出物加合物（drug-leachable adducts）生成。這類交互作用產物若引發免疫原性反應，將是生物製劑最嚴重的安全風險之一。
blocks.en: Leachables can include new substances that were not detected as extractables! The chemical environment of the drug product matrix can induce oxidation, degradation or the formation of drug-leachable adducts. If such interaction products trigger an immunogenic response, they are among the most serious safety risks for biologics.

blocks.zh: 方法驗證須符合 ICH Q2(R1)，特別注意藥品基質干擾（product & method interference）——生物製劑中蛋白質本身可能遮蔽或放大訊號。
blocks.en: Method validation must comply with ICH Q2(R1), with particular attention to product and method interference: in biologics, the protein itself may mask or amplify the signal.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 Amaran 的 CDMO 情境中，當客戶提供彈性體組件的供應商萃取物資料包時，應確認：
blocks.en: In Amaran's CDMO setting, when a client provides a supplier's extractables data package for an elastomeric component, confirm the following:

blocks.zh: 方法適用性試驗（method suitability）是否在代表性基質中執行？
blocks.en: Was method suitability testing performed in a representative matrix?

blocks.zh: 報告中每個峰的識別層級是 unknown / tentative / confirmed？
blocks.en: Is the identification tier of every peak in the report stated as unknown, tentative or confirmed?

blocks.zh: 是否有 drug-leachable adduct 的評估（尤其對抗體類藥物）？
blocks.en: Has drug-leachable adduct formation been evaluated (especially for antibody drugs)?

blocks.zh: 這些是 regulatory reviewer 必問的三個問題。
blocks.en: These are the three questions a regulatory reviewer will ask.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼萃取物研究可接受半定量，而浸出物研究需要完整方法驗證（ICH Q2(R1)）？
blocks.en: Why is semiquantitation acceptable for extractables studies, whereas leachables studies require full method validation (ICH Q2(R1))?

blocks.zh: 若某浸出物為 "tentative" 識別，且濃度高於閾值，下一步應如何處理？
blocks.en: If a leachable is identified only as "tentative" and its concentration is above the threshold, how should it be handled next?

blocks.zh: drug-leachable adduct 對蛋白質藥物的潛在免疫原性風險機轉是什麼？
blocks.en: What is the mechanism by which a drug-leachable adduct could pose an immunogenicity risk for a protein drug?

blocks.zh: 5.7 Threshold Evaluation 閾值評估
blocks.en: 5.7 Threshold Evaluation

blocks.zh: 閾值評估的兩個應用層面：
blocks.en: Two applications of thresholds:

blocks.zh: 第一層（萃取物研究）： 利用閾值篩選出需要進一步識別和毒理評估的化合物，減少不必要的詳細鑑定工作
blocks.en: Level 1 (extractables study): Use thresholds to screen out the compounds that need further identification and toxicological evaluation, reducing unnecessary detailed identification work

blocks.zh: 第二層（浸出物研究）： 低於閾值的浸出物無需個別毒理評估，大幅降低評估工作量
blocks.en: Level 2 (leachables study): Leachables below the threshold do not need individual toxicological evaluation, which greatly reduces the evaluation workload

blocks.zh: AET（Analytical Evaluation Threshold，分析評估閾值）： 將毒理閾值轉換為可直接比對分析數據的濃度限值。≥AET 的化合物必須被識別、定量並提交毒理評估。
blocks.en: AET (Analytical Evaluation Threshold): Converts a toxicological threshold into a concentration limit that can be compared directly with analytical data. Compounds at or above the AET (≥ AET) must be identified, quantified and submitted for toxicological assessment.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy — AET 與 ICH Q3D 的框架對比
blocks.en: Analogy: AET versus the ICH Q3D framework

blocks.zh: AET 的設計邏輯與 ICH Q3D 元素雜質（Elemental Impurities）閾值框架高度相似：
blocks.en: The design logic of the AET closely resembles the threshold framework for ICH Q3D elemental impurities:

blocks.zh: ICH Q3D 為每種元素（如鉛、鎘、鎳）設定 PDE（Permitted Daily Exposure），再由給藥量換算出製劑中的濃度限值（J3 值）
blocks.en: ICH Q3D sets a PDE (Permitted Daily Exposure) for each element (for example lead, cadmium, nickel) and then converts it, using the dose, into a concentration limit in the drug product (the J3 value)

blocks.zh: AET 同理：從 PQRI-PODP 的毒理閾值出發 → 除以每日劑量與暴露體積 → 得到可直接比對 LC/GC 數據的分析濃度限值
blocks.en: The AET works the same way: start from the PQRI-PODP toxicological threshold, divide by the daily dose and exposure volume, and obtain an analytical concentration limit that can be compared directly with LC/GC data

blocks.zh: 兩者都是「從患者安全出發，反推至分析方法的靈敏度要求」的風險基礎框架。
blocks.en: Both are risk-based frameworks that "start from patient safety and work backwards to the sensitivity required of the analytical method."

blocks.zh: 而 SCT（Safety Concern Threshold，安全關注閾值） 的概念則類似 TTC（Threshold of Toxicological Concern，毒理關注閾值）——即在缺乏化合物特異性毒理資料時，以一個保守的通用暴露值作為可接受的安全下限，對於低於該閾值的未知化合物，假設其不構成安全顧慮。
blocks.en: The concept of the SCT (Safety Concern Threshold) is similar to that of the TTC (Threshold of Toxicological Concern): when no compound-specific toxicological data are available, a conservative generic exposure value is used as the acceptable safety floor, and unknown compounds below that threshold are assumed not to pose a safety concern.

blocks.zh: PQRI-PODP 結論尚未最終確定！ TR73（2015）出版時，PODP 的閾值建議仍屬 intermediate（中期）建議，尚未獲得 FDA/EMA 正式背書。製藥廠商必須自行建立科學合理的閾值方案，並納入毒理學專家意見，不能直接引用 PQRI-PODP 數值作為法規依據。
blocks.en: The PQRI-PODP conclusions are not yet final! When TR73 (2015) was published, the PODP threshold recommendations were still intermediate and had not been formally endorsed by the FDA or EMA. Manufacturers must establish their own scientifically justified threshold approach, incorporating input from toxicology experts, and must not cite PQRI-PODP values directly as a regulatory basis.

blocks.zh: 三類化合物對應的三個閾值層級詳見原報告 Appendix IV；AET 的計算還需考慮給藥途徑、劑量頻率與暴露容積，方法學計算見 Appendix IV。
blocks.en: The three threshold levels corresponding to the three classes of compounds are described in Appendix IV of the original report. The AET calculation must also take into account the route of administration, dosing frequency and exposure volume; see Appendix IV for the calculation methodology.

blocks.zh: 公式與概念 Formula / Framework
blocks.en: Formula / Framework

blocks.zh:
PQRI-PODP 閾值分類框架（概念示意）：

Class 1 (已識別，有毒理資料)
  → 以化合物特定 TDI / ADI 計算個別 AET

Class 2 (已識別，無充分毒理資料)
  → 以 SCT（類似 TTC）作為安全下限，計算 AET

Class 3 (未識別 / Unknown)
  → 以最保守閾值處理，或要求進一步識別

AET 概念換算：
  AET (μg/mL) = 毒理閾值 (μg/day) ÷ 每日給藥量 (mL/day)

類比 ICH Q3D：
  J3 (μg/g) = PDE (μg/day) ÷ 最大日劑量 (g/day)
blocks.en:
PQRI-PODP threshold classification framework (conceptual illustration):

Class 1 (identified, toxicological data available)
  → Calculate an individual AET from the compound-specific TDI / ADI

Class 2 (identified, insufficient toxicological data)
  → Use the SCT (similar to the TTC) as the safety floor and calculate the AET

Class 3 (unidentified / unknown)
  → Apply the most conservative threshold, or require further identification

Conceptual AET conversion:
  AET (μg/mL) = toxicological threshold (μg/day) ÷ daily dose volume (mL/day)

Analogy with ICH Q3D:
  J3 (μg/g) = PDE (μg/day) ÷ maximum daily dose (g/day)

blocks.zh: 若某浸出物濃度低於其 AET，是否意味著絕對安全？請說明閾值方法的局限性。
blocks.en: If the concentration of a leachable is below its AET, does that mean it is absolutely safe? Explain the limitations of the threshold approach.

blocks.zh: AET 和 ICH Q3D 的 PDE/J3 框架在邏輯上有何相似之處？有何差異（化合物種類、資料來源）？
blocks.en: What are the similarities in logic between the AET and the ICH Q3D PDE/J3 framework? What are the differences (types of compounds, source of data)?

blocks.zh: SCT 與 TTC 都是「保守通用限值」，在什麼情況下需要用化合物特異性毒理資料取代？
blocks.en: The SCT and the TTC are both "conservative generic limits." Under what circumstances should they be replaced with compound-specific toxicological data?

blocks.zh: 5.8 Conclusion 結論
blocks.en: 5.8 Conclusion

blocks.zh: E&L 評估的完整閉環必須包含三要素：
blocks.en: A complete E&L evaluation loop must include three elements:

blocks.zh: 識別與定量（Identify & Quantify）： 確認所有相關浸出物的化學身分與濃度
blocks.en: Identify & Quantify: Confirm the chemical identity and concentration of all relevant leachables

blocks.zh: 安全性建立（Safety Establishment）： 透過閾值或化合物特異性毒理評估確認患者安全
blocks.en: Safety Establishment: Confirm patient safety through threshold-based or compound-specific toxicological evaluation

blocks.zh: 品質影響評估（Quality Impact）： 透過長期穩定性試驗確認浸出物不影響藥品有效性與 CQA
blocks.en: Quality Impact: Confirm through long-term stability studies that leachables do not affect drug product efficacy or CQAs

blocks.zh: 變更管理是 E&L 管理的核心陷阱： 任何容器/供應商/製程變更，都可能引入新的浸出物或改變既有浸出物的濃度水準。
blocks.en: Change management is the central pitfall of E&L management: Any change in container, supplier or process may introduce new leachables or alter the concentration levels of existing ones.

blocks.zh: E&L 的持續管理就像餐廳食材供應商管理：
blocks.en: Ongoing E&L management is like supplier management for a restaurant's ingredients:

blocks.zh: 初次評估 = 對每種食材做完整食安檢測（extractables 全面偵測）
blocks.en: Initial assessment = a full food safety test of every ingredient (comprehensive detection of extractables)

blocks.zh: 穩定性試驗 = 長期追蹤料理後的安全性（leachables in real formulation）
blocks.en: Stability studies = long-term tracking of safety after cooking (leachables in the real formulation)

blocks.zh: 供應商換原料 = 必須重新評估（change control → reassessment）
blocks.en: Supplier changes an ingredient = must be reassessed (change control → reassessment)

blocks.zh: 定期審查 = 食安標準更新時（新技術、新法規 → periodic review）
blocks.en: Periodic review = when food safety standards are updated (new technology, new regulations → periodic review)

blocks.zh: 在餐廳無法「假設原料沒變」；在 CDMO，供應商的任何製程微調都必須透過變更管理系統觸發重新評估。
blocks.en: A restaurant cannot "assume the ingredients have not changed"; in a CDMO, any process fine-tuning by a supplier must trigger reassessment through the change management system.

blocks.zh: Continued Process Validation（持續製程驗證）整合 E&L： 這是 TR73（2015）對後續法規趨勢的前瞻性指引。FDA 2011 Process Validation Guidance 將驗證從一次性活動擴展為持續監控（Stage 3：Continued Process Verification）。E&L 的定期審查正好可以整合進此框架——並非僅在上市前執行一次，而是商業生命週期中的持續品質保證活動。
blocks.en: Integrating E&L into Continued Process Verification: This is TR73 (2015)'s forward-looking guidance on later regulatory trends. The FDA 2011 Process Validation Guidance extended validation from a one-time activity to continuous monitoring (Stage 3: Continued Process Verification). Periodic E&L review fits naturally into this framework: it is not performed just once before marketing, but is an ongoing quality assurance activity across the commercial life cycle.

blocks.zh: 這與 ICH Q10 藥品品質系統（PQS）的精神完全一致：Change Management + Continual Improvement。
blocks.en: This is fully consistent with the spirit of the ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System (PQS): Change Management + Continual Improvement.

blocks.zh: 在 Amaran 的 CDMO 作業中，E&L 管理的操作要點：
blocks.en: In Amaran's CDMO operations, the key operating points for E&L management are:

blocks.zh: 供應商審計（Vendor Audit）： 建立供應商變更通知協議（Change Notification Agreement），確保任何配方或製程微調即時觸發 E&L 重評估
blocks.en: Vendor Audit: Establish a Change Notification Agreement with suppliers so that any formulation or process fine-tuning immediately triggers an E&L reassessment

blocks.zh: 穩定性方案整合： 在客戶穩定性測試計畫中明確納入浸出物測試時間點（通常 T=0, 6M, 12M, 24M, 36M）
blocks.en: Stability program integration: Explicitly include leachables testing time points in the client's stability testing plan (typically T=0, 6M, 12M, 24M, 36M)

blocks.zh: E&L Package 週期審查： 建議每 3 年或有重大製程/法規變更時進行一次全面審查
blocks.en: Periodic review of the E&L package: A comprehensive review is recommended every 3 years or whenever there is a major process or regulatory change

blocks.zh: GMP 文件控制： E&L 評估報告屬受控文件，任何更新須依變更控制程序執行，並在批次記錄中追溯
blocks.en: GMP document control: E&L assessment reports are controlled documents; any update must follow the change control procedure and be traceable in the batch record

blocks.zh: 當彈性體供應商從 Formulation A 換至 Formulation B（宣稱等效），E&L 評估是否需要重頭做？為什麼？
blocks.en: When an elastomer supplier switches from Formulation A to Formulation B (claimed to be equivalent), does the E&L evaluation need to be redone from scratch? Why?

blocks.zh: 浸出物測試與穩定性測試整合的好處是什麼？各有哪些局限性？
blocks.en: What are the benefits of integrating leachables testing with stability testing? What are the limitations of each?

blocks.zh: 「持續製程驗證」概念如何具體應用於 E&L 的商業生命週期管理？請設計一個簡單的監控計畫框架。
blocks.en: How can the concept of "continued process verification" be applied specifically to E&L life cycle management? Design a simple monitoring plan framework.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary (5.6–5.8)
blocks.en: Section Summary (5.6–5.8)

blocks.zh: 5.6 數據評估： 萃取物可半定量；浸出物需 ICH Q2(R1) 完整驗證；化合物識別分三層（unknown / tentative / confirmed）；浸出物可能在藥品基質中形成新物種（drug-leachable adducts），需評估免疫原性風險
blocks.en: 5.6 Data Evaluation: Extractables may be evaluated semiquantitatively; leachables require full ICH Q2(R1) validation; compound identification has three tiers (unknown / tentative / confirmed); leachables may form new species in the drug product matrix (drug-leachable adducts), so immunogenicity risk must be evaluated

blocks.zh: 5.7 閾值評估： PQRI-PODP 建立三類閾值框架（尚非正式法規）；AET 是毒理閾值的分析轉換值，邏輯類似 ICH Q3D 元素雜質 PDE 框架；SCT 類似 TTC，為缺乏特定毒理資料時的保守通用下限；閾值應用可大幅減少不必要的個別毒理評估工作
blocks.en: 5.7 Threshold Evaluation: PQRI-PODP established a three-class threshold framework (not yet formal regulation); the AET is the analytical conversion of a toxicological threshold, with logic similar to the ICH Q3D elemental impurities PDE framework; the SCT is similar to the TTC and serves as a conservative generic floor when compound-specific toxicological data are lacking; applying thresholds can greatly reduce unnecessary individual toxicological evaluation work

blocks.zh: 5.8 結論： 完整 E&L 評估需涵蓋識別、定量、安全評估、品質影響四大要素；變更管理是 E&L 持續合規的核心機制；E&L 定期審查可整合至持續製程驗證（Continued Process Validation）框架
blocks.en: 5.8 Conclusion: A complete E&L evaluation must cover four elements: identification, quantification, safety assessment and quality impact; change management is the core mechanism for sustained E&L compliance; periodic E&L review can be integrated into the Continued Process Verification framework

blocks.zh: 監管核心： E&L 不是一次性上市前活動，而是貫穿產品生命週期的持續責任，體現 ICH Q10 持續改善精神
blocks.en: Regulatory takeaway: E&L is not a one-time pre-marketing activity but an ongoing responsibility across the product life cycle, reflecting the continual improvement spirit of ICH Q10
